events.palestinianChildrenWinterClothes: Winter Clothes Donation for Palestinian Children
events.palestinianChildrenWinterClothesDesc: You participated in donating winter clothes for Palestinian children, successfully helping over 200 children survive the winter. Thank you for your generous donation!

events.internationalReliefAction: International Charity Organizations Joint Relief Action
events.internationalReliefActionDesc: Large-scale relief operations conducted jointly with International Red Crescent, Islamic Relief organizations, providing emergency aid to disaster-affected areas.
events.blockchainCharityWorkshopDesc: Successfully held technology workshop exploring how to use blockchain technology to improve transparency and traceability of charitable donations.
events.gazaMedicalAidDesc: Providing emergency medical supplies and equipment to Gaza hospitals, urgently needs your support. Every donation can save lives.
events.orphanEducationSupportDesc: Long-term support for orphans to receive education, giving them opportunities to change their destiny. Currently supporting 500 orphans, target 1000.
events.mosqueWellConstructionDesc: Building wells in water-scarce areas to provide clean drinking water for local Muslim communities. One well can serve an entire village.
events.charityPromotionRewardFundDesc: Providing reward incentives for volunteers who actively promote charity concepts and participate in public welfare activities. Spreading good deeds and continuing love.
events.entrepreneurshipFundDesc: Providing financial support for young Muslims with entrepreneurial dreams, helping them achieve their business goals and create more job opportunities.
events.dreamFundDesc: Supporting children from disadvantaged families to pursue their educational dreams, providing comprehensive assistance including tuition and living expenses.
events.pensionFundDesc: Providing basic living support for elderly Muslims lacking security, ensuring their later years are dignified and secure.

customerService.services:
🏆 Our Core Services:
💰 Charitable Donations - Various charity project donations
📈 Investment Management - Fund investment and profit distribution
👑 VIP Membership - Exclusive benefits and premium services
🌍 Overseas Employment - Global job opportunity applications
🎁 Reward Withdrawal - Profit withdrawal and benefit collection
